text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—The strongest Umamusume has been decided 
right here.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hype it up, everyone! And keep your eyes 
fixed on me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I shall grant you all even greater 
excitement. Yes, next is—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —It's the 'Arima Kinen'.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Come and witness my strength, surpassing 
even my esteemed seniors!"
(UOOOOOOH...!)

At the "Emperor's" declaration of war, the 
loudest cheer of the day erupted!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —And that is how it stands, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I want to take on the Arima Kinen with 
this momentum.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's a race that requires the support of 
every spectator; just being able to 
participate is an honor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Still, naturally, that alone is not 
enough to satisfy. What is sought 
is—victory."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Heh... Understood.

And so, just as the next race was set to 
be the Arima Kinen...
Pardon the intrusion.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Good work.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Brian. How unusual for you to come 
watch me."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I was curious to see who the strongest 
Umamusume truly was.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
And the winner is... you, as expected. 
Impressive as always, "Emperor".

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If I couldn't, I wouldn't deserve to stand 
above you, would I?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...I'd like to test my skills against you 
someday. Sinking my teeth into you sounds 
like fun."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'll take you on anytime. If it's just a 
little love bite, I don't mind pampering 
you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hmph...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Come to think of it, is Air Groove not 
here today?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps it was conceit to think you'd 
come watch. Or... did something go wrong?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...Your prying couldn't be any more 
obvious. That's not like you at all."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: No, I haven't done anything to—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Are you worried whether I'm keeping up 
unless you look back?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: "...Anyway, I've seen who the winner is."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Well, get some good rest.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, I owe you one.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Trainer-kun. About what Brian 
just said—"
(Knock knock...)

text_block_list.name: Female Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me, I'm from the newspaper company. 
Do you have a moment to spare?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, not at all. Please wait a moment while 
I prepare it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, let's talk later. Right now, 
it's interview time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Leaving an impression of victory, plus 
the outlook for the next race. We need the 
press corps to really hype it up."

"...However, I was kept busy with 
interviews after that, and never got the 
chance to speak with Symboli Rudolf."
